gloss: counter for suits and sets of clothing

definitions.gloss: counter for suits and sets of clothing
definitions.explanation: Counts complete outfits or sets of clothing such as suits, dresses, and uniforms. One {着|ちゃく} is one full set worn together.

examples.japanese: スーツを{二着|にちゃく}{買|か}った。
{制服|せいふく}を{三着|さんちゃく}{用意|ようい}する。
クリーニングに{出|だ}したコートが{一着|いっちゃく}まだ{戻|もど}ってこない。
examples.english: One of the coats I sent to the cleaners still hasn't come back.
